neutral_start: Cube/bowl centers aligned in robot-left-right coordinate within 5 mm; separated front-to-back; cube supported.
goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.
goal_margin: Cube center at least 30 mm left or right of bowl center in robot frame.
proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; proposed left endpoint; proposed right endpoint; optional annotated top view.
main_design_priority: Grasp clearance and clear landing routes on both sides; avoid table edge and bowl.

neutral_start: Cube/bowl centers at same height within 5 mm; separate grounded supports; bowl at intermediate height.
goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube higher than the bowl.
goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube lower than the bowl.
goal_margin: Released cube center at least 30 mm higher/lower than bowl center.
proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; proposed higher endpoint; proposed lower endpoint; annotated side elevation.
main_design_priority: Grounded upper/lower supports; arm clearance; transport path avoids bowl.

neutral_start: Cube equally distant in 3D from bowl and plate centers within 5 mm difference; supported, distinct visible anchors.
goal_a: Put the Rubik's cube closer to the bowl than to the plate.
goal_b: Put the Rubik's cube farther from the bowl than from the plate.
goal_margin: Requested cube-to-anchor distance advantage at least 30 mm.
proposed_design_pictures: Neutral start; near-bowl endpoint; near-plate endpoint; annotated top view and side view if heights differ.
main_design_priority: Recognizable plate, stationary anchors, separate safe supported landing regions.
